summary: Fixes the Delete account button, which looked disabled while it was active, refreshes dependencies and moves the release and dev build pipelines to the shared actions.

changes.description: Delete account page: the Delete account button no longer looks disabled while it is active; it uses the red cancel style.
Dependencies refreshed within their current major versions.

Releases are now prepared from the release files in publication/, which are validated on every pull request that touches them, and dev images and charts are built on the dev branch with the shared actions.
